title: ConsentWithdrawn
description: A previously granted consent was withdrawn or lapsed. Terminal for the `consent_id`. Withdrawal does not by itself trigger erasure; that is a separate request with its own basis.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the data subject. Subject whose consent ended.

consent_id.description: Consent being withdrawn. Matches a prior consent-granted.

reason.description: Why the consent ended. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
